title.zh: 消耗 5000 亿 token 之后：让 AI 智能体反编译一款第一人称射击游戏
title.en: 500B tokens later: Letting AI agents decompile a first-person shooter

current_state.zh:
开发者 momo5502 发布博文，描述了一项实验：AI 智能体消耗约 5000 亿个 token，将一款商业第一人称射击游戏反编译到字节级一致的汇编代码。该文在 Hacker News 上引发大量讨论，内容涉及成本、所用的智能体架构，以及功能性等价是否足够。

这篇博文为智能体式 LLM 工作流的成本提供了一个具体的大规模样本，把 5000 亿 token 的消耗与单个逆向工程项目直接挂钩。评论者将其视为一个证据：与追求功能性等价相比，字节级一致的反编译是一个刻意昂贵的目标。

字节级一致（matching）反编译指的是编写原创 C++ 代码，并用与当年一致的编译工具链编译，使其生成的机器码与已发布的二进制文件逐字节相同。一位评论者引用博文称，作者此前发布的两篇文章已被删除。
current_state.en:
Developer momo5502 published a blog post describing an experiment in which AI agents consumed roughly 500 billion tokens to decompile a commercial first-person shooter down to byte-matching assembly. The post, which drew a large Hacker News thread, discusses the cost, the agent architecture used, and whether functional equivalence would have been enough.

The post provides a concrete, large-scale datapoint on the cost of agentic LLM workflows, attaching a 500-billion-token figure to a single reverse-engineering project. Commenters read it as evidence that byte-matching decompilation is a deliberately expensive target compared with functional equivalence.

Byte-matching (matching) decompilation means writing original C++ that, compiled with the era-correct toolchain, produces byte-for-byte the same machine code as the shipped binary. According to a commenter quoting the post, two earlier posts by the author have since been removed.

updates.background_zh: 字节级一致的反编译是一项成熟的逆向工程实践，其目标是编译产物与原始二进制完全一致。面向编码智能体的逆向工程工具也在陆续出现，而诸如 Faultless 论文等学术工作则专门研究神经反编译中的程序等价性问题。评论者指出，作者对所涉游戏拥有约十年的模组（modding）经验，并曾从事该游戏的漏洞挖掘工作。
updates.background_en: Matching decompilation is an established reverse-engineering discipline in which the goal is a compiled artifact identical to the original binary. Agent-based reverse-engineering tooling for coding agents has also been emerging, and academic work such as the Faultless paper addresses program equivalence for neural decompilation. Commenters noted the author has roughly a decade of modding experience with the game in question and prior work on game exploits.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 在约 101 条评论的 Hacker News 讨论中，主流观点认为推高成本的是字节级一致这一目标本身，而非智能体：多位评论者认为若只追求功能性等价，token 消耗会低得多，其中一人描述了自己的工作流——让智能体编写语义等价但不完全相同的代码并附带测试。另有一些讨论聚焦智能体架构，认为在复杂系统中人类的品味仍无可替代；还有人质疑模型选择，认为那是“虚假的节约”。
updates.community_discussion_en: In a roughly 101-comment Hacker News thread, the dominant view was that the byte-matching goal, not the agents, drove the cost: several commenters argued functional equivalence would use far fewer tokens, with one describing a workflow where an agent writes semantically equivalent code plus tests instead. Others focused on agentic architecture, arguing there is still no substitute for human taste in complex systems, and one questioned the model choice as a false economy.
